head: 2d85d89a82ae74aac74ac418cffb30287d163b3b
says: The kalfa/config copy of the next/** rule block in .oxlintrc.json is held by no law, so it can drift from the next/** block without a red check.
proof: edge-config.test.ts law 3 compares only the .agents/ mirror with the next/** block; no test reads the override whose files are ["kalfa/config/src/**", "kalfa/config/*.ts"].
cost: A rule added to the next/** block later can miss kalfa/config, and kalfa/ is then held to less than next/'s rules (0556) with no check to say so.
